Q2 (historical reconciliation): a one-time sweep MAY be warranted -- a manifest recorded REFRESH_COMPLETED_WITH_ADDITIONS with delta.previous_entry_count=0 while an earlier COMPLETED-family manifest for the same firm genuinely existed is a manifest the pre-fix code could have mis-written (compared against None instead of the true prior entry set).
